Thirty-one duplicate groups are not repeated roots at all. Thirty involve two or more of the seven atoms currently flattened to `an der bezeichneten Stelle`; the remaining case is `G407-E4353`, where `LOCAL_CHAR_I` and `G_LABEL` both sound like `mit der lokalen Variante`.

This makes a plain `zweimal` rule actively misleading. The better next move is a small common `STELLENVERWEIS`/`VARIANTENVERWEIS` family whose learned short labels keep `D_ADDR`, `A_ADDR`, `AM_ADDR`, `LOCAL_CHAR_F`, `M_LOCAL`, `S_ADDR`, `D_LABEL` and the variant atoms distinguishable. The labels are analytical sigla, not claimed Voynich pronunciations.

decision: Keep IDEA000019 as at-most-one method-review candidate with this unit restriction; do not treat current attachment defaults, 75 replayed bindings, or renderer success as semantic or complete-whole confirmation.
